title: Thesis RAG
description: Document-grounded research assistant with Flask, OpenAI-backed question answering and cited sources. Supports PDF/DOCX/TXT ingestion, web and YouTube sources, FAQ management, query history, review of unanswered questions, and an authenticated administrative interface.
features: Answer questions from uploaded files and supported external content
Show source references alongside grounded answers
Manage source documents, FAQs and unanswered user questions
Review new questions and promote administrator responses into FAQ entries
workflow: Ingest and extract uploaded or linked content
Create searchable embeddings and retrieve relevant passages
Route unresolved questions through an administrative review process
summary: Document-grounded research assistant with cited answers, FAQ management and admin review of unanswered questions.
